next_recommendation: TF-IDF formal suite COMPLETE at 174k. Two-mode tradeoff REPRODUCED: citation-based signals (cited_decisions_tfidf + outcome hybrids) PASS adversarial gates (LangDom~0.45-0.53, Jurist~0.61-0.81) but FAIL citation_heritage (recall@10 0.04-0.05). Text-based signals (full_text_tfidf_light, regeste_full_text hybrids) FAIL adversarial gates (LangDom=1.0, Jurist=0.0) but PASS citation_heritage AUC (~0.85-0.90). v17b label normalization: citation-based signals show uniform improvement (4-10% purity gains); text-based signals DEGRADE 30-34% on zoom_fine. Citation_heritage NEGATIVE at 174k for ALL TF-IDF reps (AUC ~0.48-0.90, recall@10 ~0.00-0.12). Dense embeddings, citation roles, linear hybrids AWAITED from legal-distance (3/26 years ACCEPTED; years 2003-2019 pending audit). Jurist human study framework ready but requires 5-10 Swiss jurists. No further same-question cycle justified.

critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_reproduced_174k: Fundamental tradeoff persists at 174k: Citation-based (LangDom PASS, Jurist PASS, CiteHeritage FAIL) vs Text-based (LangDom FAIL, Jurist FAIL, CiteHeritage AUC PASS but recall@10 FAIL). Production default cited_decisions_tfidf_outcome_hybrid_0.5 is best citation-based: LangDom=0.516, Jurist=0.806, CiteHeritage AUC=0.760.
critical_findings.citation_heritage_negative_174k: ALL 8 TF-IDF representations FAIL citation_heritage at 174k (recall@10 < 0.2 threshold). Best recall@10: full_text_tfidf_light=0.052, cited_decisions_tfidf=0.044. Citation graph coverage only 0.1% (174/173,963 decisions). Citation-independent retrieval near-zero for citation signals; text signals achieve AUC 0.85-0.90 but collapse on adversarial gates.
critical_findings.v17b_label_normalization_174k: 49.3% labels normalized (214→164 unique areas). Citation-based signals: uniform 4-10% purity gains across hierarchy/zoom/legal_area. Text-based signals: hierarchy/legal_area stable but zoom_fine DEGRADES 30-34% (confirmed at 174k scale). Uniform improvement FALSE.
critical_findings.adversarial_benchmarks_hnsw_artifact_fix: Exact k-NN on stratified subsample (n=2000) confirms HNSW artifact fix. 5/8 reps PASS both gates. Production default confirmed PASS.
critical_findings.boilerplate_resistance_negative: All TF-IDF reps FAIL boilerplate resistance (resistance_score ≈ -0.57 to -0.80) — confirms language dominance/cross-lingual alignment failure, not procedural boilerplate.
critical_findings.temporal_stability_mixed: full_text_tfidf_light PASS (0.78 overlap), others FAIL (0.0-0.38). Scale stability remains challenging.
critical_findings.hierarchy_coherence_low: All TF-IDF reps FAIL Jurivoc proxy (level_0_nmi < 0.3, level_1_nmi < 0.2). Best level_1_nmi: full_text_tfidf_light=0.563.
